title: Refutation calculi for lattice-based logics: from display to tableaux
summary: Refutation calculi are formal systems developed to derive the invalid formulas of a given logic. While the notion of refutation calculi has played a key role in the development of tableaux calculi, a refutation approach to display calculi has not yet been attempted. In this paper, we introduce refutation display calculi for basic LE-logics, i.e., those logics canonically associated with basic normal lattice expansions of any signature.
